def search(arr):
    """
    Find the element that appears only once in a sorted array
    where every other element appears exactly twice.
    """
    n = len(arr)
    lo, hi = 0, n - 1
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        # Ensure mid is even so pairs align
        if mid % 2 == 1:
            mid -= 1
        if arr[mid] == arr[mid + 1]:
            lo = mid + 2
        else:
            hi = mid
    return arr[lo]
